---
title: "Nairaland rationales plot"
author: Casey Breen
---

Summary: Create figure showing the rationales posters give for low-fertility
ideals (0-3 children) on Nairaland, 2010-2018, most to least common
(lollipop). Rationale codes come from LLM coder passes under a fixed
codebook; shares are among low-ideal posts that give any rationale.

```{r}
## Library packages
library(here)
source(here("code", "helpers.R"))
```

## load rationale codes

```{r}
## one row per ideal post with its rationale codes, assembled by
## code/scraping/5_build_coding_batches.R from the LLM coding outputs
rat <- read_csv(here("data", "nairaland", "coded_output", "rationales_coded.csv"))
```

## create plot

```{r}
## low-ideal posts (0-3 children) that give any rationale
low <- rat %>%
  filter(ideal_n <= 3, !is.na(rationales), rationales != "")
n_low <- nrow(low)

cats <- c(economic_cost = "Economic cost / affordability",
          child_quality = "Child quality / education",
          career_aspiration = "Career / personal goals",
          womens_autonomy = "Women's autonomy / health",
          family_planning = "Family planning practicalities",
          modern_western = "Modern / Western comparison",
          religion_blessing = "Religion / divine blessing",
          lineage_continuity = "Lineage / family continuity",
          security_status = "Children as security / status",
          traditional_norm = "Tradition / custom")

## share of low-ideal posts giving each rationale, most to least common
shares <- map_dfr(names(cats), function(cc) {
  tibble(cat = cats[[cc]],
         share = mean(str_detect(low$rationales, cc)))
}) %>%
  arrange(desc(share)) %>%
  mutate(cat = factor(cat, levels = rev(cat)))

nairaland_rationales_plot <- ggplot(shares, aes(x = 100 * share, y = cat)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 100 * share, yend = cat),
               colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3.4, stroke = 1.1, shape = 21,
             colour = "darkblue", fill = "white") +
  labs(x = "Share of posts giving this rationale (%)", y = NULL,
       subtitle = sprintf("Low-fertility ideals (0-3 children), 2010-2018, n = %d", n_low)) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"))

## Save plot
ggsave(plot = nairaland_rationales_plot,
       filename = here("figures", "nairaland_rationales_plot.png"),
       height = 5, width = 7.3, bg = "white", dpi = 300)
```
